newsitem.title: UK: Panamax strength continues in dry cargo market.
newsitem.headline: Panamax strength continues in dry cargo market.

text.p: The BFI cleared 1,500 on Friday for the first time since Nov 18 with an 11 points jump to 1501.
Brokers said continued Panamax strength, especially in the Atlantic, was largely responsible for the BFI rising 48 points this week.
Higher levels were seen in the two major grain routes, US Gulf/Holland and US Gulf/Japan, and timecharter rates for trips US Gulf/far East and for transatlantic business have risen.
Brokers reported a number of factors likely to continue to influence the freight market in owners' favour.
They cited a good supply of orders into January from US Gulf, for example, Port congestion in Brazil and Argentina as well as Japan, and bad weather in the Med and elsewhere.

Brokers believed Caper prospects were good beyond the end of the year in the Pacific, but were not so confident the current strength in the Atlantic, boosted by prompt grain enquiry, will be sustained.

The situation for Handy-Sizes on the Continent is not encouraging for owners, but elsewhere in the Atlantic demand is said to be good. Handy fixtures reported from the Pacific have shown some improvement for owners this week.
GRAIN - The US Gulf/Japan trade has featured reports of Yukong booking NSAC tonnage at $26.00 no combo and rumours of Shinwa fixing $25.75 no combination for first half and mid Jan respectively.

Timecharter is still more common in these trades and European Maritime Carriers are understood to have taken the Belships-relet Anangel Venture 69,400 dwt delivery Bremen about Dec 20 for 3-5 months redelivery far east at $13,850 daily, the intended first leg said to be US Gulf/Japan grain.
Thetis 73,000 dwt is rumoured fixed delivery Ghent Dec/Jan trip via US Gulf to the far east at $15,250 daily.
Reports of the Merchant Pride 69,700 dwt fixed delivery US Gulf Jan 1/10 trip far east for account of HMM at $15,000 daily plus $290,000/300,000 bonus could not be verified.
The geared Panamax Maerskanjong 70,400 dwt was believed fixed delivery Bremen Dec 23 for a trip east for S.Korean account on private terms.

Capers fixed in the grain trades included Finix 123,125 dwt spot Rotterdam for a voyage via Mississippi to Holland with Dreyfus at a firm $12,000 daily (for a 1977-built vessel), and Theogennitor 116,978 dwt to Geepee on subjects for US Gulf/Saudi Arabia.

Irisl were reported to have fixed 70,000 grains Nopac/Iran for Jan at $18.40. Klaveness quoted an enquiry for 60/76,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Hamburg for Dec 20/Jan 5 (ideas $13.50), and Glencore 20,000 meals Up River/China for Dec/Jan.

Glencore were linked with Yannis K for 22,000 wheat Plate/Cuba for prompt loading at close to $29.00. But, brokers said, the most striking Handy fixture reported today was the 1977-built Zara 1,080,000 cft to Cargill prompt US Gulf/Holland or UK (limited disbursements) at $21.00 basis 55 ft (equating to about $18.25 basis heavy grain to Holland).
This fixture contrasts with reports that Cargill have just also fixed Maritime Talent 47,574 dwt US Gulf/Holland at $13.25 basis 49'.

MINERALS - Private Caper ironore fixtures were understood to have been completed by China Steel Seven Islands/kaohsiung and Klaveness for 140,000/10 Tubarao/Beilun for Jan 15/30, possibly at about $9.00/9.25.
Mount Athos was said to have failed with 150,000 Tubarao/Revadanda with Cobelfret and to have been covered for other business.

News of Panamax involvement in the minerals trades was limited but Sumav 70,120 dwt was linked with Ruhrkohle for coke from N.China to the Continent at $21.00, and Chariot to HMM for 40,000 coke Xingang/Continent or Fos for Dec/Jan at $16.90.
HANDY-SIZES - Brokers reported the Continent and Med as very flat for geared tonnage, although J Lauritzen were believed to have taken a 39,000 dwt vessel for period in this area.

In the east Archimedes 39,000 dwt was also fixed for short period basis delivery Japan on private terms, and Pisces Planter 35,000 t was booked by Halla delivery Nopac end dec trip Far East at $7,300 daily plus $145,000 bonus.
IVS were said to have fixed Las Bolinas 28,600 dwt delivery S.Africa trip Continent at close to $5,000 daily.
